name: Null Meridian Productions
description: An illegal production collective operating from rotating locations in the Shelf's abandoned transit infrastructure, Null Meridian Productions creates unauthorized neural-feed content that directly depicts corponation atrocities, Shelf conditions, and suppressed historical events. Their work is distributed exclusively through pirate mesh networks and physical dead drops. No member of the collective has ever been publicly identified, and Vantablack's enforcement division has twice raided locations they believed housed NMP operations, finding only equipment and no personnel.
cultural_impact: Their 2209 production depicting the Ward Nine substrate trials from the perspective of the subjects became the most-shared piece of underground content in Meridian history, forcing three separate corponation PR responses.
story_hooks: NMP has reached out through three layers of dead drops requesting an escort for their most important production yet — they need someone with legitimate Tier 3 access
A Vantablack enforcement agent has turned and claims to know the identities of two NMP collective members, but their price is steep
Someone is selling what they claim is the unfinished NMP archive — everything they produced but never released — and the buyer pool includes people who would use it for very different purposes
